tests.scenario: Free content label is shown before opening content
steps: Browse to a content card that is available for free
Observe the content card before tapping it
tests.expected_result: The content card displays a Free label before the user opens it.

tests.scenario: Subscription-only content label is shown before opening content
steps: Browse to a subscription-only session or course
Observe the content card before tapping it
tests.expected_result: The content card displays a Trial or Subscription Required label before the user opens it.

tests.scenario: Trial details are shown before confirmation
steps: Open a subscription offer with a free trial
Proceed to the purchase confirmation screen
Review the information shown before confirming
tests.expected_result: The confirmation screen displays the trial duration, renewal price, renewal date, and cancellation method before the user confirms.

tests.scenario: Paid subscription details are shown before confirmation
steps: Open a paid subscription offer without a trial
Proceed to the purchase confirmation screen
Review the information shown before confirming
tests.expected_result: The confirmation screen displays the price, renewal terms, renewal date, and cancellation method before the user confirms.

tests.scenario: Active subscriber can view subscription management screen
steps: Sign in with an account that has an active subscription
tests.expected_result: The screen shows the current plan, billing status, next renewal date, and a visible cancellation path.

tests.scenario: Trial user can view subscription management screen
steps: Sign in with an account that is currently in a trial period
tests.expected_result: The screen shows the trial status, renewal date, plan details, and a visible cancellation path.

tests.scenario: Online meditation starts within five seconds
steps: Connect the device to a stable internet connection
Tap Play and measure the time until audio begins
tests.expected_result: Playback begins within 5 seconds.

tests.scenario: Online sleep session starts within five seconds
steps: Connect the device to a stable internet connection
Tap Play and measure the time until audio begins
tests.expected_result: Playback begins within 5 seconds.

tests.scenario: Downloaded content plays in airplane mode
steps: Download a meditation or sleep session while online
Enable airplane mode on the device
Open the downloaded session and tap Play
tests.expected_result: The downloaded session starts and continues playing without an internet connection.

tests.scenario: Previously downloaded content remains accessible offline after app restart
steps: Enable airplane mode and play the downloaded session
tests.expected_result: The downloaded session remains accessible and plays without an internet connection after the app restarts.

tests.scenario: Playback position is preserved after forced app close
steps: Wait until the session reaches the middle
Reopen the app and return to the same session
tests.expected_result: The app offers a Resume option from the last saved playback position.

tests.scenario: Playback position is preserved after connection interruption
steps: Wait until the session reaches the middle
Temporarily disconnect the device from the internet
tests.expected_result: The app offers a Resume option from the last saved playback position after the interruption.

tests.scenario: Sign-in help provides password reset and account recovery options
tests.expected_result: The app shows password reset, email-based account recovery, and sign-in method switching options.

tests.scenario: User can switch sign-in method during account recovery
tests.expected_result: The app allows the user to switch to a different sign-in method without restarting the recovery flow.

tests.scenario: Repeated failed sign-in shows specific error and action
steps: Submit the same invalid sign-in attempt twice
tests.expected_result: The app shows a specific error message, explains the likely cause, and presents at least one corrective action or support option.

tests.scenario: Authentication loop is interrupted with guidance
steps: Follow a sign-in path that repeatedly returns to the login screen
Attempt the same login flow twice
tests.expected_result: The app interrupts the loop with a specific error message and offers a corrective action or support option.

tests.scenario: Subscribed user regains premium access after successful login
steps: Sign in with an account that has an active subscription
Wait for the home screen to load
tests.expected_result: The subscription-only session is accessible immediately without repurchase.

tests.scenario: Subscription access remains restored after app relaunch
steps: Sign in with an account that has an active subscription
Verify access to a subscription-only session
Return to the same subscription-only session
tests.expected_result: The subscription-only content remains accessible after relaunch without requiring the user to repurchase or restore manually.

tests.scenario: Daily Meditation is reachable in two taps or fewer
steps: Count the number of taps used
tests.expected_result: Daily Meditation is reached in 2 taps or fewer.

tests.scenario: Sleep and Favorites are reachable in two taps or fewer
steps: Count the number of taps used for each destination
tests.expected_result: Sleep and Favorites are each reached in 2 taps or fewer.

tests.scenario: Search returns matching content items
steps: Enter a keyword related to an existing session or course
tests.expected_result: The app returns matching sessions, courses, or sleep content related to the keyword.

tests.scenario: History or saved content allows reopening previous sessions
steps: Complete or start at least one session
Open the app history, saved content, or recent activity section
tests.expected_result: The previously used session appears in history or saved content and can be reopened from the results.

tests.scenario: Quick-start section includes breathing, meditation, and sleep options
tests.expected_result: The quick-start section includes one-tap access to a breathing exercise, a short meditation, and a sleep option.

tests.scenario: Quick-start options launch immediately from the home screen
tests.expected_result: Each quick-start option launches directly from the home screen with a single tap.

tests.scenario: Multiple session lengths are shown before playback
steps: Open a meditation that offers multiple durations
tests.expected_result: The app displays the available session lengths before playback begins.

tests.scenario: Selected session length is applied correctly
steps: Open a meditation that offers multiple durations
tests.expected_result: The session starts using the duration selected by the user.

tests.scenario: Completed sessions appear in progress history
steps: Complete at least one session while signed in
Open the progress or profile history screen
tests.expected_result: The completed session appears in the user's progress history.

tests.scenario: Milestones or streak information is visible after repeated use
steps: Use the app to complete sessions on multiple occasions
Open the progress or profile history screen
tests.expected_result: The screen displays visible progress indicators such as completed sessions, streaks, or milestones associated with the account.
